description: React component for an announcement bar with customizable styles, tooltip, and close functionality, used in Mattermost web application.

classes.name: AnnouncementBar
classes.description: A React component that displays an announcement bar with various styles, icons, and optional tooltip and close button.

methods.name: enableToolTipIfNeeded
methods.description: Enables tooltip if the message element's width exceeds its scroll width, indicating overflow.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Increments announcement bar count, adds fixed class to body, and sets CSS variable for height calculation.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Updates CSS variable and class based on changes in announcement bar count.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Decrements announcement bar count and removes fixed class and CSS variable if no bars remain.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Handles close button click, calls optional handleClose prop.
